releaseTitle: ATalk v3.13.0 — Comprehensive App-Wide UI/UX Polishing, True ZXing QR & Offline ML Kit Scanner, Carrier-Grade Low-Bandwidth Agora Calling, and Privacy Hardening
releaseNotes:
• 01 True ZXing QR Code Generation & Offline ML Kit Scanner: Full ISO/IEC 18004 standard QR generation across My Identity, Group Invites, User Profile, and Key Fingerprint verification. CameraX PreviewView with Google ML Kit Barcode Analyzer for instantaneous offline QR scanning with hardware torch control.
• 02 Low-Bandwidth VoIP & Echo Elimination Calling Pipeline: Carrier-grade Agora RTC pipeline optimized for 2G/3G weak networks (capping Opus speech to 18 kbps, Audio DTX silence transmission at 2 kbps, Audio/Video In-Band FEC, Dual Stream Mode with 160x120 @ 10fps low stream, and automatic audio-only fallback under extreme packet loss). Aggressive AI Acoustic Echo Cancellation (AI-AEC) and AI Noise Suppression (AI-ANS mode 2).
• 03 Reorganized In-Call Responsive Control Dock: Streamlined 4-button dock (Mute, Speaker, Camera, Flip/Share) preventing button overcrowding on compact screens (< 360dp), dedicated Screen Share pill chip, and Picture-in-Picture mode on minimize.
• 04 Per-Chat Dynamic Theme & Wallpaper Integration: ChatRoomScreen wrapped in CompositionLocalProvider(LocalATalkPalette provides palette) with customStyleVersion state invalidator, ensuring per-chat palettes immediately recolor all speech bubbles, composer surfaces, and action sheets.
• 05 Aspect-Ratio Precise Photo Redaction Tool: Fixed pixel coordinate mapping in PhotoRedactionDialog using exact letterbox/pillarbox margins (toBitmapCoords) and dynamic pixel-density scaling for accurate blur and pixelation brushstrokes.
• 06 Layout & System Bar Polish: Resolved floating capsule double elevation shadows, eliminated doubled scaffold padding in Notes, corrected pushpin toggle state, applied statusBarsPadding and navigationBarsPadding to incoming disguised call and story viewer screens, and fixed pinned chats reorder sheet height constraints.
• 07 UI Logic & State Hoisting Fixes: Resolved raw UUIDs to contact names in chat search results, connected reactive userDisplayNameFlow/userHandleFlow to navigation drawer for instant updates, and enforced uniform OTP verification when linking phone/email on ProfileScreen.
• 08 Jargon Cleanup & Text Harmonization: Replaced alarming and military jargon ('Obliterate', 'Shred', 'Tactical', 'scrcpy', 'FLAG_SECURE') with clean, professional consumer messaging, standardized 'Updates' navigation tab, and strictly enforced 6-digit Master PIN validation.
